title: outbox delivery does not send read receipts back to sender after inbound message
description: When DeliverHandler receives an inbound message, it does NOT enqueue an outbox entry for a Peer/receipt 'delivered' acknowledgement. The outbox only handles 'receipt' entries for messages the owner read (read receipts). According to the architecture, 'delivered' receipts are reserved for future use (commented in build_peer_receipt_request: 'delivered is reserved for future use'). This is intentional and documented. No bug. Filing as P2 efficiency note: if delivered receipts are added later, the enqueue must happen in DeliverHandler immediately on message receipt, not in a separate step.
